backend_mode.label: Wallpaper Engine
backend_mode.description: Use Noctalia native surface or custom command.

custom_command.label: Custom Command
custom_command.description: Command template executed on selection. Use {path} and {output} placeholders.

post_hook_command.label: Post-Apply Hook
post_hook_command.description: Optional command run after applying a wallpaper (e.g. matugen image "{path}").

animate_selected_card.label: Animate Selected Card
animate_selected_card.description: Enable subtle floating and transition animation on the active center card.

visible_deck_cards.label: Visible Deck Cards
visible_deck_cards.description: Number of cards rendered simultaneously in the deck window (3 to 11).

wallhaven_api_key.label: Wallhaven API Key
wallhaven_api_key.description: Optional API key for Wallhaven (unlocks NSFW and personal collections).

wallhaven_purity.label: Wallhaven Purity
wallhaven_purity.description: Purity bitflag (SFW/Sketchy/NSFW, e.g. 100 for SFW only).

wallhaven_sorting.label: Wallhaven Sorting
wallhaven_sorting.description: Default sorting on Wallhaven (toplist, hot, relevance, views, favorites, random).

wallhaven_hires_preview.label: Hi-Res Wallhaven Preview
wallhaven_hires_preview.description: Enable full resolution background previews for Wallhaven wallpapers.

wallhaven_cache_limit_mb.label: Wallhaven Preview Cache Limit (MB)
wallhaven_cache_limit_mb.description: Maximum disk space for hi-res previews before older cached previews are automatically pruned (50 to 2000 MB).

wallhaven_download_dir.label: Wallhaven Download Directory
wallhaven_download_dir.description: Directory where applied Wallhaven wallpapers are saved (defaults to WallHaven in your wallpaper directory).
